method: Read the actual ingest-v3 (prompt v2, gemini-2.5-flash-lite) captions and sightings written to production for album Re7kho after an in-place reprocess, and compared four of them against the frames viewed directly (acc-v-jca-35, 075, 20, 40). 120/120 captions pass the caption contract (two needed the too-long correction; the correction message now targets 25 words and forbids an unchanged resubmission, after a 31-word caption came back verbatim). 77/120 captions name a jersey number (52/120 under ingest-v2), average 24 words, no relationship, emotion, outcome, aesthetic or swimwear claims found. Defects observed and left recorded: acc-v-jca-35's caption assigns #16 to the player in blue when #16 is the player in white (the sighting row is correct); bench players in warmups are still written as sightings on acc-v-jca-35 (#1 #12 #13 #14 #5 white, #21 black), a known limitation the prompt v2 eval chose not to address because a role field cost precision; acc-v-jca-40's white #5 is not legible to a human at 1000px. Captions still open with 'A player' 84/120.
scope: four captions checked against the frames
